notes.title: Next Fest summary📃✨ Your questions❓
notes.content:
Dear students, we have some fantastic news to share with you! Let's dive right in:

Steam Next Fest -  February 2024

We want to express our gratitude to all the amazing players who participated in the Steam Next Fest in February. 🎮✨ Over 8000 of you downloaded the demo, and we are thrilled to announce that nearly 660 players have already given it a try! The average playtime of the demo so far is 25 minutes, and we have received an overwhelming 20 bug reports. 🐛🔍 Rest assured, we are diligently working through them to improve the game based on your valuable feedback. Thank you all for your support! 🤝✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815993/34dd4a4d7bc5187d25915cce5e1da83033e3bf67.png

What Do You Want to Know 🤔🔍?
We value your curiosity and want to address all your burning questions about Secret School! 🤔✨ Leave a comment and let us know what interests you the most. Your feedback and inquiries mean the world to us!

 Share your own opinion about "Secret School" 📺:
Your thoughts 💭 and experiences are incredibly valuable to us and other players. We have created a Content Creator Kit where every influencer/creator gets all the information and assets for the game in one place. Showcase your exciting experiences to the world!

Thank you for being a part of this amazing community. Let's continue to uncover the secrets of the school together. Stay tuned for further updates! 🎉✨💫

Your team of Secret School

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2526360/Secret_School

notes.title: Secret School Livestream and Q&A #2
notes.content:
Join the Secret School Showcase at Steam Next Fest! 🎮 
Welcome to Steam Next Fest! In this stream, I will be showing you things you can do in Secret School. I will be answering any questions you have as they come up in the chat.

 📅 Save the Date:
Set a reminder so you don't miss out on being among the first to experience the Secret School ➡️

https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/drive-viewer/AEYmBYQDrq8GqDUHPAbpmcmhQ-S0ggmrUUKBtRse4XQgMcefUFGHIZbvYsU1TvXV16j8B7VckDN4tmFROkXq-GV7qycpDBX2=w1920-h919

"Secret School" is a single player computer game in the adventure genre. During the game, you can complete your plan for the day or explore corridors and rooms. You should beware of the cameras and the guard who is watching over you. The ending of the game will differ depending on your actions. ✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815993/77a65a9d71892466f181474dd82e287c57bcc850.png

Looking forward to seeing you!

Cheers,
your team of Secret School

notes.title: 🚨Streamers & Content Creators🚨 Your Support is Needed!
notes.content:
We want to be honest with you 😊, there is only one drawback: there are only 4 students in our Secret School. 😲💔

Do you want to join to our Secret School?  🎮💫 

exciting action adventure game 
challenges and riddles at every step 
multiple endings 

👋👨‍🎓Our doors are open to you! 

We have created a Content Creator Kit where every influencer/creator gets all the information and assets for the game in one place. Showcase your exciting experiences to the world! 📺🌍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44815993/74384984bd2ea7e0a34b201fbf770139ad7a5db5.png

🌟Your Invaluable Feedback:
Your thoughts 💭 and experiences are incredibly valuable to us and other players. We kindly encourage you to share your honest opinions about "Secret School". Remember, your reviews not only help us but also guide other adventurers in understanding and enjoying the world of "Secret School". 🌌

Thank you for being a part of this amazing community. Let's continue to uncover the secrets of the school together. 🔮✨

Cheers,
your team of Secret School
